_readme: PF1e Table: Familiar (the wizard Familiar class feature), expanded from the printed 2-level
brackets to one row per master level 1-20 for direct lookup by class_func/familiars.py.
natural_armor_adj and int_score are the CUMULATIVE values in effect AT that level (not deltas);
'special' lists abilities NEWLY gained at that exact level -- concatenate rows 1..level for the
full list. int_score REPLACES the species' own Int once bonded (RAW: the table's Int always
wins). spell_resistance, when gained, equals master level + 5 and is computed in code, not here.
species_perks: the master-facing bonus each species grants (the '+3 Fly' table) -- kept in this
file, not familiar_choices.json, so the species stat blocks stay pure creature data.
ability_notes: one-line rules text per special ability, shipped to the sheet via the entry's
master_abilities field. Source: d20pfsrd wizard Familiar page, fetched 2026-08-12.

special: speak with animals of its kind

species_perks.hawk: +3 bonus on sight-based Perception checks in bright light
species_perks.owl: +3 bonus on sight-based Perception checks in shadows

ability_notes.alertness: While the familiar is within arm's reach, the master gains the Alertness feat.
ability_notes.improved evasion: On a Reflex save for half damage, the familiar takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.
ability_notes.share spells: The master may cast a spell with a target of 'You' on the familiar (as a touch spell) instead of on himself.
ability_notes.empathic link: The master and familiar share an empathic link to 1 mile; the master cannot see through its eyes.
ability_notes.deliver touch spells: The familiar can deliver touch spells for the master if in contact with him when he casts.
ability_notes.speak with master: The master and familiar can communicate verbally as if using a common language.
ability_notes.speak with animals of its kind: The familiar can communicate with animals of approximately its own kind.
ability_notes.spell resistance: The familiar gains spell resistance equal to the master's level + 5.
ability_notes.scry on familiar: The master may scry on his familiar (as the scrying spell) once per day.
